Canvas: Living room — the catch (scene_livingroom_catch) | Node: Living room — the catch



[IMAGE MISSING] scenes/scene_livingroom_catch.jpg

Living room late evening. Maya on the couch under a blanket, phone in one hand showing something flushed-looking, her other hand under the blanket. TV on low. Her cheeks flushed. Frank in the doorway, key still in his hand, frozen.

She thought he was already in bed. The TV's on low. Her phone's open to something she shouldn't be watching with the door open. The blanket's over her lap and her other hand isn't on the phone.

She doesn't hear his step in the hall until the floorboard creaks at the doorway.

Frank's in the doorway. Key still in his hand from coming in the back door. He doesn't move. He sees the phone screen. He sees the blanket. He sees the way her hand is moving under it. He sees her see him.

Frank: Maya.
Don't move.









Sit there in the dark.
